actions.text: ASSUMING FIRST SPONSORSHIP - Mr. Gallagher asked unanimous consent that he may hereafter be considered as the first sponsor of H.R. 4970, a bill originally introduced by Representative LaMalfa, for the purpose of adding cosponsors and requesting reprintings pursuant to clause 7 of rule XII. Agreed to without objection.
Referred to the Subcommittee on Water, Wildlife and Fisheries.
Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts water users associated with the Orland Unit Water Users Association and the Sacramento Canal Unit of the Central Valley Project.
dimensions.evidence: upon the request of the Orland Unit Water Users Association... water from the Orland Project to the Sacramento Canal Unit

dimensions.assessment: Facilitates water availability and transfers upon request, while explicitly protecting existing vested water rights and preventing redirected impacts.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this section may be construed to... affect any valid or vested water right

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state specific federal spending authorizations or revenue changes associated with the water transfers.
Amends section 104 of the Reclamation States Emergency Drought Relief Act of 1991 to add a specific transfer exception.
dimensions.evidence: Section 104 of the Reclamation States Emergency Drought Relief Act of 1991 (43 U.S.C. 2214) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent statutory exception for water transfers that can be utilized when requested and approved.
dimensions.evidence: at any time, without regard to water year type

missing_information: Volume of water expected to be transferred annually is not specified.
Cost or pricing details for the water transfers are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill facilitates temporary water transfers from the Orland Project to the Central Valley Project under certain conditions without altering existing water rights.
